description: The file is a PHP class definition for 'Login' within the OpenCart e-commerce platform, specifically handling user login actions within the account controller namespace. It includes methods for rendering login page, handling login requests, token-based authentication, and managing session data during login/logout processes.

classes.name: Login
classes.description: This class handles user login, token validation, session management, and redirects related to user authentication within the OpenCart account module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the login page and handles redirection if the user is already logged in with a valid token.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Processes AJAX login requests, validates credentials, manages login attempts, sets session data, and returns JSON responses with redirect URLs or errors.

methods.name: token
methods.description: Provides a token-based login mechanism, mainly intended for admin or override login, validating tokens, managing sessions, and redirecting appropriately.
